content.bridge_context: We look closely at the plant kingdom to classify plants based on their size and stems, and understand the functions of different parts.

units.title: Classification: Herbs, Shrubs, Trees
units.explanation: Herbs (soft green stems), Shrubs (woody stems branching from base), Trees (hard tall trunks).
units.dual_language_instruction: Observe plants in your garden or school. / अपने बगीचे या स्कूल में पौधों का निरीक्षण करें।

units.title: Structure and Function
units.explanation: Roots (anchorage, water absorption), Stem (conduction), Leaves (photosynthesis, transpiration).
units.dual_language_instruction: Draw a diagram of a plant and label parts. / एक पौधे का चित्र बनाएं और भागों को नाम दें।
